The tenth season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] series, released on DVD as the {{nihongo|'''Arrancar vs. Shinigami arc'''|破面・VS.死神篇|Arankaru VS. Shinigami Hen}},<ref name="vol1">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B001V30UBO|title=Bleach 破面·VS.死神篇 1|trans-title=Bleach Arrancar vs. Shinigami hen 1 DVD|language=ja|access-date=April 7, 2009}}</ref> is directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]], and produced by [[TV Tokyo]], [[Dentsu]], and [[Studio Pierrot]].<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ Bleach =ブリーチ=|trans-title=Pierrot Bleach =Staff=      |publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=April 7, 2009}}</ref> The season adapts [[Tite Kubo]]'s ''[[Bleach (manga)|Bleach]]'' [[manga]] series from the rest of the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol32|32nd]] volume to the [[List of Bleach chapters#vol35|35th]] volume (chapters 286–315), with the exception of episodes 204 and 205 ([[Filler (media)|filler]]). The season continues with [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] and his friends, surviving the battle against the [[List of hollows in Bleach#Espada|Espadas]] and assisted by a few [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach|Soul Reapers]].

The season aired from October 2008 to February 2009 on TV Tokyo.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes17/|script-title=ja:第189-200|trans-title=Episodes 189-200|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=January 19, 2009|archive-date=October 6, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121006173113/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes17/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes18/|script-title=ja:第201-213|trans-title=Episodes 201-213|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=November 3, 2009|archive-date=January 27, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130127234317/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes18/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The English adaptation of the anime is licensed by [[Viz Media]],<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2006-03-15/viz-officially-announces-bleach-anime|title=Viz Officially Announces Bleach Anime|date=March 15, 2006|website=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=April 13, 2009}}</ref> and aired on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] from February to May 2011.<ref name="first"/> Aniplex released the season in a series of DVD compilations, with each of the four volumes containing four episodes. The first DVD volume was released on May 27, 2009, and the fourth one on August 26 of the same year.<ref name="vol1"/><ref name="vol4">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B002CFRQ3U/|title=Bleach 破面·VS.死神篇 4 DVD|trans-title=Bleach Arrancar vs. Shinigami hen 4 DVD|language=ja|access-date=September 3, 2006}}</ref>

The episodes use three pieces of theme music: one opening theme and two closing themes. The opening theme is "Velonica" by [[Aqua Timez]].<ref name="ep190">{{cite episode|title=ウェコムンド編、再会!|series=Bleach|credits=TV Tokyo, Dentsu, Studio Pierrot|network=TV Tokyo|airdate=October 14, 2008}}</ref> The first ending theme, "[[Hitohira no Hanabira]]" by [[Stereopony]], is used for episode 190 to 201, and the second ending theme, {{nihongo|"Sky Chord (Otona ni Naru Kimi e)"|Sky chord 〜大人になる君へ〜|Sukai Kōdo ~Otona ni Naru Kimi e~|{{lit|Sky Chord (To the Adult You)}}}} by [[Shion Tsuji]], is used for the remainder.<ref name="ep190"/><ref name="ep202">{{cite episode|title=激動決着!最強は誰だ|series=Bleach|credits=TV Tokyo, Dentsu, Studio Pierrot|network=TV Tokyo|airdate=January 13, 2009}}</ref> To promote the third feature film, ''[[Bleach: Fade to Black]]'', which was released on December 13, 2008, the credits from episodes 197 through 201 use [[Teaser (trailer)|teaser]] footage.<ref name="ep197">{{cite episode|title=白夜の哉卍解、静かなる怒り|series=Bleach|credits=TV Tokyo, Dentsu, Studio Pierrot|network=TV Tokyo|airdate=December 2, 2008}}</ref>

| ShortSummary    = After the fight between [[Ichigo Kurosaki]] and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez|Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez]] concludes when Ichigo breaks through Grimmjow's strongest attack, Grimmjow attempts to continue the fight, but is attacked by [[List of hollows in Bleach#Nnoitra Gilga|Nnoitra Gilga]], an Espada. However, Ichigo protects Grimmjow. As Ichigo and Nnoitra begin to fight, Tesla Lindocruz, Nnoitra's subordinate, captures [[Orihime Inoue]]. Nnoitra reveals that he is the Fifth Espada and is stronger than Grimmjow. Meanwhile, [[Renji Abarai]], [[Uryū Ishida]], [[List of hollows in Bleach#Pesche Guatiche|Pesche Guatiche]] and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Dondochakka Bilstin|Dondochakka Bilstin]] attempt to flee the Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Szayelaporro Grantz|Szayelaporro Grantz]], but because Szayelaporro controls the building they are in, he redirects the hallways to point back towards their battlefield.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF
}}

| ShortSummary    = Nnoitra overpowers the tired Ichigo, and when Orihime attempts to help, Tesla threatens to destroy her hair clips, the source of her power which would allow her to stop Tesla. Szayelaporro releases his ''[[List of hollows in Bleach#zanpakutō|zanpakutō]]'' and creates clones of Renji, Uryū, Pesche and Dondochakka. Furthermore, he releases the power limiter in the room to allow Renji and Uryū to fight at full power. Meanwhile, Nnoitra encounters Nel and recognizes her. When Ichigo asks how he knows Nel, Nnoitra reveals Nel's true name is [[List of hollows in Bleach#Neliel Tu Odelschwanck|Neliel Tu Odelschwanck]], indicating that she is a former Espada.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF

{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 10
| EpisodeNumber   = 192
| EpisodeNumber2  = 3
| Title           = Nel's Secret, A Busty Beauty Joins the Battle!?
| TranslitTitle   = Neru no Himitsu, Kyonyū Bijo Sansen!?
| NativeTitle     = ネルの秘密、 巨乳美女参戦!?

| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2008|10|28}}
| AltDate         = February 20, 2011<ref name="Secondschedule"/>
| ShortSummary    = Nnoitra uses Nel as a shield against Ichigo, whom he pins to the ground. As he prepares to break Ichigo's arm, the intensity of Nel's emotions causes her to return to her original adult form, Neliel. Pesche and Dondochakka realize that Nel has transformed into her original form, and feel nostalgic. Neliel takes Ichigo away from the battlefield, and as she prepares to fight Nnoitra, she reveals that she was the former Third Espada. She overpowers Nnoitra, and in desperation, Nnoitra uses a ''[[List of hollows in Bleach#cero|cero]]'' blast. Neliel uses her Cero Doble technique to absorb Nnoitra's ''cero'' and redirect it at him with doubled force. However, Nnoitra is relatively unharmed, and reveals that the Espada have grown stronger in her absence.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF
}}

In response, Szayelaporro destroys the clones, and uses another ability of his released form to create voodoo dolls of his opponents. Meanwhile, Nnoitra and Neliel fight each other to a stalemate, and Nnoitra states that he despised Neliel even during her time as an Espada.

| ShortSummary    = Nnoitra recalls his past encounters with Neliel, in which Neliel sparred with Nnoitra and easily defeated him. In one session, Nnoitra demanded that she continue the fight until one of them died, and Neliel refused. As a result, Nnoitra attacked Neliel's subordinates, Pesche and Dondochakka, and with Szayelaporro's aid, paralyzed Neliel long enough for him to land an attack on her. He left her outside Aizen's palace, where she transformed into an amnesiac child, in which form Pesche and Dondochakka vowed to protect her. In the present, Nnoitra taunts Neliel about their past and Neliel prepares to release her ''zanpakutō''.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF

Ichigo tries to help Nel, and Nnoitra allows Tesla to fight him. After releasing his ''zanpakutō'', Tesla starts to torture the exhausted Ichigo. Before Tesla can deal the final blow, Soul Reaper captain [[Kenpachi Zaraki]] stops him.

| ShortSummary    = Kenpachi defeats Tesla in one blow and tells Ichigo to stay out of his fight with Nnoitra. He informs Ichigo that [[List of Bleach characters#Kisuke Urahara|Kisuke Urahara]] was tasked with making the ''garganta'' gateways into [[Bleach (manga)#Setting|Hueco Mundo]] stable enough for Soul Reaper captains to enter, and that three other captains came with him. Captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Retsu Unohana|Retsu Unohana]] arrives with her lieutenant, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Isane Kotetsu|Isane Kotetsu]], and they stop [[List of hollows in Bleach#Rudbornn Chelute|Rudbornn Chelute]] and the Exequias from killing [[Yasutora Sado|Yasutora "Chad" Sado]] and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Gantenbainne Mosqueda|Gantenbainne Mosqueda]]. Captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Mayuri Kurotsuchi|Mayuri Kurotsuchi]] and his lieutenant, [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Nemu Kurostsuchi|Nemu Kurotsuchi]], arrive and Mayuri is confident that he can win against Szayelaporro, even after Szayelaporro creates a voodoo doll of him. Captain [[Byakuya Kuchiki]] arrives to save [[Rukia Kuchiki]] from Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Zommari Leroux|Zommari Leroux]], and overcomes Zommari's enhanced speed with the techniques [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Yoruichi Shihōin|Yoruichi Shihōin]] taught him.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF
}}

Byakuya immobilizes Rukia with ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#kidō|kidō]]'', and uses his ''bankai''. Surrounded by thousands of tiny blades, Zommari is overwhelmed by the attack.

| ShortSummary    = Rukia regains consciousness, and Byakuya tells her to rest and regain her strength for the impending battles. Kenpachi battles Nnoitra, and Orihime heals Nel at Ichigo's request. While swallowing Szayelaporro with his ''bankai'', Mayuri inadvertently poisons Uryū and Renji, and Szayelaporro seizes the opportunity to resurrect himself by absorbing Nemu's spiritual particles through his Gabriel technique. However, in the process, he ingests a "superhuman" drug from inside Nemu that increases all of his senses to the point where his body cannot respond to the flood of sensory information, immobilizing him with Mayuri stating that one second would feel like a century. He then stabs Szayelaporro through the hand before stabbing him in the heart.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF

| WrittenBy       = Genki Yoshimura
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2009|1|20}}
| AltDate         = May 8, 2011<ref name="fourthchedule">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.adultswim.com/schedule/tools/img/on-air-schedule.jpg |title=Revised 4/25/2011 |publisher=[[Adult Swim]] |access-date=April 29, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110513215854/http://www.adultswim.com/schedule/tools/img/on-air-schedule.jpg |archive-date=May 13, 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
| ShortSummary    = After Kenpachi defeats Nnoitra, the Espadas [[List of hollows in Bleach#Coyote Stark & Lilinette Gingerbuck|Coyote Stark and Lilinette Gingerbuck]] arrive and carry Orihime away to a tower, where [[Sousuke Aizen]] greets her. He informs her that he, [[Gin Ichimaru]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Kaname Tōsen|Kaname Tōsen]] are preparing to destroy [[Bleach (manga)#Setting|Karakura Town]]. Aizen orders Tōsen to contact the Soul Reaper captains, Ichigo, and his friends with ''kidō'', and reveals that he brought Orihime to Hueco Mundo to lure and trap them. While he travels through a ''garganta'' portal to Karakura Town, however, first division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]], the leader of the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Gotei Thirteen|Thirteen Court Guard Squads]] confronts Aizen, with five other captains. Aizen summons the Espadas Stark and Lilinette, [[List of hollows in Bleach#Baraggan Louisenbairn|Baraggan Louisenbairn]], and [[List of hollows in Bleach#Tier Halibel|Tier Halibel]] and orders Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Ulquiorra Schiffer|Ulquiorra Schiffer]] to protect Las Noches. Ichigo, sensing the threat to Orihime, flies off to save her.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF
}}

| ShortSummary    = In the real world, Ichigo is in school when he see [[List of Bleach characters#Lurichiyo Kasumiōji|Lurichiyo Kasumiōji]], who has come back to the real world because she is angered that Ryūsei "Kenryū" Kenzaki, her retainer, would not allow her to play [[kemari]] when she has other important duties. This leads to an outburst between Lurichiyo and Kenryū, and Kenryū intends to kill himself to make Lurichiyo "happy". After Ichigo and his friends persuade Kenryū, they put on an act to fool Lurichiyo into forgiving him, but she sees through the trick. This leads to another argument and culminates in Lurichiyo challenging Kenryū to a kemari game to see who is right.

| TranslitTitle   = Doki! Horō Darake no Kemari Taikai
| NativeTitle     = ドキ！虚だらけの蹴鞠大会

| ShortSummary    = The kemari game officially starts. The referees are the proprietors from the Urahara Shop, [[List of Bleach characters#Jinta Hanakari|Jinta Hanakari]] and [[List of Bleach characters#Ururu Tsumugiya|Ururu Tsumugiya]]. [[List of Bleach characters#Kisuke Urahara|Kisuke Urahara]] himself oversees the proceedings, and set up a gigantic barrier around the play field to indicate the assigned area. The two teams, each with varying characters attempt to keep the ball away from each other in different, comical ways. [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Ikkaku Madarame|Ikkaku Madarame]] joins in the game, while sparring with Ichigo under the impression that he was undergoing intensive training. Then a hollow appears on the field, drawn by everyone's spiritual pressure. With the help of Ichigo, Uryū and Chad, the hollow is quickly dispatched, but the game ends because Lurichiyo's team dropped the ball. Before she can lament about going back to her world, Shū Kannogi enters the human world and shows Lurichiyo that her idea about a kemari tournament in the Soul Society was not such a bad idea in the eyes of the commoners after all. Satisfied at this, Lurichiyo returns to the Soul Society.
| LineColor       = 30BFBF
